# Wondershare EdrawMax

> EdrawMax is an AI-powered diagramming platform supporting 210+ diagram types with cross-platform accessibility, enterprise collaboration, and seamless Microsoft Office integration.

EdrawMax offers both desktop and online solutions for creating professional diagrams, flowcharts, mind maps, and organizational charts. The platform emphasizes AI-assisted diagram generation, extensive template libraries, and compatibility with industry standards like Visio, serving individual users, teams, and educational institutions.
